metadata.description: Read-only skills for working with a local Windows Outlook (Classic) mailbox: status, search, threads, calendar, and .msg/.eml files.

plugins.name: outlook
plugins.description: Read-only Outlook skills: outlook-status, outlook-search, outlook-thread, outlook-agenda, outlook-availability, outlook-open-msg, plus outlook-settings and outlook-memory (local settings and personal memory with first-run onboarding). Never modifies mailbox data.
